name: ECOVACS WINBOT W2 PRO Omni
description: A suction-mounted window-cleaning robot with a safety tether and edge-detection sensors for frameless glass. The Pro tier's cord-connected station is a portable power pack that lets it charge while actively cleaning, rather than a water-refill dock.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: The W2 Pro Omni attaches with up to 5,500 Pa suction and a tether rated to ~100kg via carabiner backup. Edge detection uses optocoupler/spherical sensors (claimed 0.2s response) plus bumpers for framed windows. Unlike Deebot "Omni" vacuum stations, this Winbot's dock isn't a water-refill/pad-washing station — it's a portable power pack that lets the Pro charge continuously while cleaning.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Price for the W2 Pro Omni is reported inconsistently across sources: Ecovacs' own store and Amazon list $499.99, while TechRadar cites a $699.99 MSRP. It's unclear whether this reflects a standing promotional price or a regional/timing difference.
